final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only paymentservice pod (paymentservice-597747d4d8-jbdgb on worker-02) is an outlier in the boutique pods listing with RESTARTS=2 while all other 10 pods show 0. Its pod detail shows Last State Terminated with Reason: Error / Exit Code 137, and kubelet events state verbatim: 'Liveness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.186:50051/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x00\x04..."' followed by 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' (x3). The malformed response bytes are HTTP/2 frame prefixes, showing the container speaks gRPC/HTTP2 on port 50051 while the probe speaks HTTP/1.x. GetAppYAML(paymentservice) confirms the misconfiguration: readinessProbe uses grpc: {port: 50051} (correct) but livenessProbe uses httpGet: {path: /, port: 50051} on the same gRPC port. Thus the liveness probe protocol is wrong, causing repeated kubelet kills (exit 137) and the observed abnormal restarts. No OOMKilled reason and no OOM events, so memory limit is not the cause.
